data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: tdesktop
edge_embedded.summary: Telegram Desktop（tdesktop）是Telegram官方推出的跨平台桌面客户端，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统，实现了与移动端完全同步的即时通讯功能。该项目采用C++编写，直接集成了MTProto协议加密层，提供端到端加密聊天和定时销毁消息等安全特性，其原生界面架构保证了低资源占用下的流畅体验。开发者可借鉴其清晰的跨平台代码组织方式，或基于开源代码定制专属客户端，例如添加自动化消息处理机器人或强化隐私管控模块，适合学习现代桌面应用开发与安全通信实践。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Telegram Desktop (tdesktop) is the official cross-platform desktop client for Telegram, enabling secure messaging across Windows, macOS, and Linux with full feature parity to mobile apps. Built in C++ for performance, it implements MTProto protocol encryption directly, offering end-to-end encrypted chats and self-destructing messages while maintaining a responsive native interface. Developers can study its clean architecture for multi-platform app design, or modify the open-source code to create custom Telegram clients with specialized features like automated bots or enhanced privacy controls.

ui_devex.name: agent-framework
ui_devex.summary: 微软推出的开源Agent Framework旨在简化AI智能体及多智能体工作流的构建与部署，通过统一编排层无缝集成Python和.NET编写的智能体，帮助开发者设计复杂协作流程。该框架能协调多个专业化智能体协同完成任务，适用于多步骤应用场景，如客户服务系统（处理查询、解答、情感分析）或研究助手（文献检索、数据分析、报告生成），实现端到端自动化。
ui_devex.summary_en: Agent Framework is a Microsoft-developed toolkit for creating and managing AI agents and multi-agent systems, addressing the complexity of coordinating multiple AI components in real-world applications. Its technical strength lies in providing a unified orchestration layer that seamlessly integrates Python and .NET agents, enabling developers to design sophisticated workflows where specialized agents collaborate on complex tasks. You can use it to build applications like customer service bots with specialized sub-agents for different query types, or research assistants where separate agents handle literature review, data analysis, and report generation in coordinated sequences.

ui_devex.name: mlx-vlm
ui_devex.summary: MLX-VLM 是一个开源工具包，专为在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地运行和微调视觉语言模型而设计，解决了依赖云端服务的限制。它基于苹果的 MLX 框架，通过高效的 GPU 加速统一处理图像和文本，实现多模态任务如图像描述和视觉问答。技术亮点在于利用 MLX 的优化能力，使模型在本地硬件上流畅执行，降低了使用门槛。用户可轻松应用它进行本地图像分析、自定义模型训练，或实验如 LLaVA 等先进模型，为研究和开发提供便捷的本地化 AI 解决方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: MLX-VLM is an open-source package that enables running and customizing vision-language models directly on Apple Silicon Macs, addressing the need for local AI without cloud dependencies. It leverages Apple's MLX framework to efficiently handle multimodal tasks by unifying image and text processing through optimized GPU acceleration. Developers can use it for local image captioning, visual question answering, or fine-tuning models like LLaVA and Florence-2 for specific applications, making advanced vision-language AI accessible on personal hardware.

framework_core.summary: 微软推出的开源Agent Framework旨在简化AI智能体及多智能体工作流的构建与部署，通过统一编排层无缝集成Python和.NET编写的智能体，帮助开发者设计复杂协作流程。该框架能协调多个专业化智能体协同完成任务，适用于多步骤应用场景，如客户服务系统（处理查询、解答、情感分析）或研究助手（文献检索、数据分析、报告生成），实现端到端自动化。
framework_core.summary_en: Agent Framework is a Microsoft-developed toolkit for creating and managing AI agents and multi-agent systems, addressing the complexity of coordinating multiple AI components in real-world applications. Its technical strength lies in providing a unified orchestration layer that seamlessly integrates Python and .NET agents, enabling developers to design sophisticated workflows where specialized agents collaborate on complex tasks. You can use it to build applications like customer service bots with specialized sub-agents for different query types, or research assistants where separate agents handle literature review, data analysis, and report generation in coordinated sequences.

framework_core.name: mlx-vlm
framework_core.summary: MLX-VLM 是一个开源工具包，专为在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地运行和微调视觉语言模型而设计，解决了依赖云端服务的限制。它基于苹果的 MLX 框架，通过高效的 GPU 加速统一处理图像和文本，实现多模态任务如图像描述和视觉问答。技术亮点在于利用 MLX 的优化能力，使模型在本地硬件上流畅执行，降低了使用门槛。用户可轻松应用它进行本地图像分析、自定义模型训练，或实验如 LLaVA 等先进模型，为研究和开发提供便捷的本地化 AI 解决方案。
framework_core.summary_en: MLX-VLM is an open-source package that enables running and customizing vision-language models directly on Apple Silicon Macs, addressing the need for local AI without cloud dependencies. It leverages Apple's MLX framework to efficiently handle multimodal tasks by unifying image and text processing through optimized GPU acceleration. Developers can use it for local image captioning, visual question answering, or fine-tuning models like LLaVA and Florence-2 for specific applications, making advanced vision-language AI accessible on personal hardware.

security_safety.name: tdesktop
security_safety.summary: Telegram Desktop（tdesktop）是Telegram官方推出的跨平台桌面客户端，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统，实现了与移动端完全同步的即时通讯功能。该项目采用C++编写，直接集成了MTProto协议加密层，提供端到端加密聊天和定时销毁消息等安全特性，其原生界面架构保证了低资源占用下的流畅体验。开发者可借鉴其清晰的跨平台代码组织方式，或基于开源代码定制专属客户端，例如添加自动化消息处理机器人或强化隐私管控模块，适合学习现代桌面应用开发与安全通信实践。
security_safety.summary_en: Telegram Desktop (tdesktop) is the official cross-platform desktop client for Telegram, enabling secure messaging across Windows, macOS, and Linux with full feature parity to mobile apps. Built in C++ for performance, it implements MTProto protocol encryption directly, offering end-to-end encrypted chats and self-destructing messages while maintaining a responsive native interface. Developers can study its clean architecture for multi-platform app design, or modify the open-source code to create custom Telegram clients with specialized features like automated bots or enhanced privacy controls.
